raw:
@s1 stated
  relation "be delivered to"
  role subject "the white ceramic planter"
  role destination "the wrong flat"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "deliver"
  role subject "the Evri driver"
  role object "the white ceramic planter"
  role time "Monday"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  select ?x
  where match
    relation "report to"
    role subject "the user"
    role object ?x
    role topic "the white ceramic planter"
    polarity affirmed
  end
